claim_reviews.claim: Malaysian answer: ibu atau bapa tunggal
claim_reviews.review: Accurate and understandable; ibu/bapa tunggal is a possible shorter variant.
Appropriate because the Indonesian and Malaysian forms differ lexically.

rationale: The English sense is accurate, both Indonesian and Malaysian Malay answers express the intended concept, and the different-common-word relation is appropriate. The Malaysian form is natural and any shorter variant is only a stylistic preference.
